script: Yasuo killed his own master. He didn't do it on purpose. In League of Legends lore, Yasuo was framed for murdering the man who trained him, using magic he never even studied. His brotherhood exiled him on the spot. No trial. No chance to explain. So what did he do? He hunted the real killer alone, armed with nothing but his blade and his pride. But here's the twist nobody talks about. His own brother, Yone, was sent to kill him for a crime Yasuo never committed. Two brothers. One truth neither of them knew. Yasuo never begged for forgiveness. He just kept walking, blade drawn, waiting for the wind to decide who was right.
